title: MAVLink Deserializer
text: Convert serialized uint8 MAVLink data stream to Simulink nonvirtual bus, 2 inputs, 2 outputs; {MAVLink dialect source} sets the source for specifying the MAVLink message definition Select from standard MAVLink, {MAVLink dialect} sets the message definition to parse for MAVLink messages, {MAVLink version} sets the mAVLink protocol version, {MAVLink Message type} sets the mAVLink message, {Input data stream length is available} sets the length of valid MAVLink data in the input byte stream, {Filter output MAVLink messages by System ID} sets the filter received messages by System ID, {System ID}, {Filter output MAVLink messages by Component ID} sets the filter received messages by System ID and Component, {Component ID}, {Queue MAVLink messages in output} enables queuing of the received MAVLink and {Number of messages to be queued} sets the size of MAVLink message queue. Values come from the instance.

ports.summary: Length of valid MAVLink data at Data input port scalar
